chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ali ibn al-Hakam, from Ali al-Ahmasy, from a man, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said:
The world is the best assistance for seeking the Hereafter.

key_terms.الآخِرَةِ: The Hereafter, the afterlife, or the ultimate end
key_terms.الدُّنْيَا: The world, worldly life, or material existence

ai.seo_question: How does the world assist in attaining the Hereafter according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this hadith from al-Kafi, Imam al-Baqir (peace be upon him) articulates the Shia principle of 'utilizing the world for the Hereafter,' affirming that material life is not an end in itself but a vital instrument (al-'awn) for spiritual success. This perspective counters ascetic withdrawal, emphasizing that worldly resources, when directed with intention, facilitate the acquisition of knowledge, charity, and worship necessary for attaining the eternal realm.
